visualCharacteristics.purpose: transparent link cards with an icon left of a bold title and a short description

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per card. Cell 1: icon (:icon-name: token, e.g. :alert:, or a small image). Cell 2: H3 title, description paragraph(s), link. The last link of the row makes the whole card clickable; if its text equals the title it is not repeated, otherwise its text is shown as a link line under the description. Cells may be merged or missing: the first icon/image is the icon, the rest is the body; a card without a link is not clickable. No label rows; all texts are authored

usage: Partner tiles (option partner) on /{country}/{lang}/digital-self-services and local promotion pages (the plain AirCore "Entry regulations" card left with the /lhg/ pages on 2026-10-25).
reuseGuidance: Use for icon + title + description link cards. For centred icon tiles with a label only use cards-icon; for image cards use cards-teaser. Icons need SVGs under /icons/ (e.g. alert.svg).
